title: Cirro 1.1.0, now on Android
summary: Your Google Drive accounts, together in a workspace made for your phone.

items.title: Three accounts, one workspace
items.description: Connect up to three Google accounts, switch between them or browse Unified, and set your own account labels and colours.

items.title: Your own Home and search
items.description: Reorder sections and widgets, pin folders, and search with account and file-type filters. Every account and Unified keeps its own Home.

items.title: Files without losing your place
items.description: Upload, download, copy, move, share and manage selected files. Stay on the current page and follow transfers in Android notifications.

items.title: Built for Android
items.description: Dark mode, accent colours, themed Cirro icons, offline storage choices and signed app updates with download progress.
